scope: Production presentation/resolver/catalog with native-shaped UI doubles; no Unity rendering

cases.name: Backpack inspection reaches native category, description and size initialization
Every backpack identity preserves its native category and storage-size text
Firearms and melee inspection also complete native initialization
Vanilla and third-party items retain their native text on a reused window
Unexamined EFB items do not disclose their rolled description
Repeated refreshes keep a single rolled block and signature
Server signature fallbacks become one instance roll
Mystery offers retain four unknown bonuses
A reflected getter failure cannot escape the presentation prefix
Missing item or labels cannot abort native inspection
